data.professional_title: Quality Consultant in Quality Management Team
data.summary: Graduate with 14 years of expertise in implementing and enhancing quality management systems, including 6 years as a dedicated quality consultant. I excel at identifying process inefficiencies, minimizing defects, and elevating operational quality. I am eager to take on challenging roles that allow me to leverage my comprehensive knowledge of quality management to drive organizational excellence and continuous improvement.

domain_and_functional: Quality Circle/Kaizen and continuous Improvement Initiative
all_skills: Quality Circle/Kaizen and continuous Improvement Initiative

responsibilities: Lead governance and lifecycle management of L3 Service Models and L4 Process Models aligned with enterprise BPM framework, Operational Risk, and regulatory compliance standards.
Design and validate BPMN 2.0 compliant process maps, ensuring audit traceability, swimlane accuracy, control points, and event-based modeling.
Execute advanced data analytics, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and control validation to mitigate operational risk and enhance control effectiveness.
Partner with Business Control Managers (BCMs), Risk, Compliance, and IRM teams to identify control gaps and strengthen the internal control environment.
Support and perform RCSA (Risk & Control Self-Assessment) including risk identification, control testing alignment, residual risk evaluation, and documentation governance.
Lead structured Change Management lifecycle, ensuring RAU validation, stakeholder approvals, version control, and governance-compliant publication in iGrafx.
Conduct SIOC (Suppliers, Inputs, Outputs, Customers) analysis to ensure end-to-end transparency, accountability, and risk alignment.
Coordinate Annual Affirmation and governance reviews to ensure adherence to enterprise risk policies and regulatory obligations.
Translate “Golden Process” future-state designs into executable Target Operating Model (TOM) roadmaps supporting digital transformation initiatives.
Define, baseline, and monitor CTQs, KPIs, and KRIs using Power BI, Minitab, and advanced Excel analytics to drive performance improvement.
Apply Lean Six Sigma, VSM, Kaizen, FMEA, and 5S methodologies to achieve defect reduction, improved TAT, SLA adherence, and productivity gains.
Contribute to AI / Gen AI use cases for process automation, compliance validation, intelligent documentation drafting, and anomaly detection in banking operations.

Utilized Minitab statistical analysis (hypothesis testing, regression, control charts, Cp/Cpk studies) to improve process capability, reduce operational losses, and enhance regulatory compliance posture.
Mentor Lean Six Sigma trained resources to deliver on their Yellow Belt and Green Belt Initiatives

Mentor Quality champions to support their Continuous Improvement Programs. Mentoring is a specific activity/ role in Lean Six Sigma where the requirement is to help Project Leads on their Green Belt and Yellow Belt projects.
Review data / facts to identify and solve issues and mitigate risks
Prioritize workload and work on ad hoc projects as assigned
Works as Lean Champion for a defined scope and responsible for Lean deployment.
Works closely with client Lean Champions for deployment and provide Lean consulting, coaching, and mentoring to stakeholders in defined scope.
Align process map as per BPMN standard.
Participates in Client discussions to understand the problem and articulate the same to internal stakeholders.
Providing the requested documents to the respected team (Mortgage, Vehicle, Aircraft, All Business Assets Boat and Ship).
Review of legal documentation to identify the discrepancies.
Handling the Market queries with regards to Documentations.
Working on escalations to ensure that the documents are sent on priority.
Preparing the release of collateral documents as per the market request (Mortgage, Vehicle, Aircraft, All Business Assets Boat and Ship
Notifying the banker regarding the closure of the loan and release of the collateral.
Worked on securing the collateral for active loan by filling UCC through CT Lien a Web based application.
Continuing the UCC filing prior to 6months from the date of expiring in order to secure the active loans. Since UCC holds good only for 5 years.

experience.role: (Operations) Customer Enablement, Loan Disbursement Operation and Mortgage Underwriter
responsibilities: Adding or removing the Client Signature from the corporate accounts as per the client request.
Updating the KYC details into the ANZ system before issuing the Transactive devices or adding signatory to the account.
Issuing the Transactive devices to the client as per requirement.
Setup of various facilities such as Overdraft, Loans, Settlement and Credit Cards.
Reviewing, examining and underwriting loans to ensure eligibility and compliance with the Banks' lending policies.
Reviewing credit report of the borrower, verifying assets and liabilities.
Extracting Titles, which is the most important document while prepare the mortgage document for the customer.

education.institution: St. Francis de sales Karnataka Secondary Education Examination
